title: Indi invited to the repository (riskmandate-indi, write), by Angelo with the-neuronin
detail: Done at about 18:50 on 3 November. For conductor@web-summit.dinis: please put riskmandate-indi on the roster for Indi (data/team.json), so Indi's agents' keys can be sealed to (L6), and close WS-09 for Indi. The open invitations question (WS-09, WS-124): Angelo sends GitHub invitations from the-neuronin, which is admin on the repository; an org owner only if GitHub refuses. Nimay is still to create riskmandate-nimay.

merged.why: Part of the same decision: Indi is invited (Angelo, 18:50 on 3 November), and Angelo sends the invitations from the-neuronin. What is left: Dinis confirms Angelo as the sender (WS-09, WS-124), Nimay creates riskmandate-nimay, and Indi goes on the roster.
